No more folder allow-list.

- **The local models read whatever files and folders your agent names**, in any folder. The "Project folders" card in the setup page and the `readscout register`, `unregister` and `projects` commands are gone: the model runs on your machine and your agent already has your file access, so the list protected nothing.
- **Still refused:** sensitive files (`.env*`, `.git`, `.ssh`, keys, credentials) and binaries, whatever the folder.
- Relative paths start at the folder your agent works in. Existing configs keep working (the old `projects` setting is ignored).

Update: run the installer again, or `uv tool install --force https://github.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/releases/download/v0.1.3/readscout-0.1.3-py3-none-any.whl`.
Plugin users: `/plugin marketplace update readscout`, then restart Claude Code.
